available_agents.description: Turns one use case described in prose into one slice proposal, as JSON.

message: An in-memory notes service. Listing returns all notes in creation order. Creating a note needs non-empty text and returns it with an id starting at 1.

description: Turns one use case described in prose into one slice proposal, as JSON.

tool_definition.name: __structured_output__
tool_definition.description: Deliver the final answer of this conversation as structured output (slice_proposal). The arguments must be a JSON object matching the tool's parameter schema. Call this tool alone, with no other tool calls in the same response; a valid call ends the turn. Expected content: The whole slice proposal as the tool's arguments, exactly as the system prompt describes it.

parameters.description: What the analyst agent may output: goals, terms, rules, examples, the contract and new questions. It holds no field the platform or the developer owns.

contract.description: An OpenAPI 3.1 document as YAML text. Every operation has an `operationId` and `x-rules: [R-<n>, ...]`. The pattern refuses text whose first non-blank character is `"` or that has no real line break after its first non-blank character, which is a JSON-encoded or once-more-escaped string rather than the YAML itself.

examples.description: Gherkin text with one `Rule:` block per rule. Every scenario is tagged `@R-<n>` with the rule of its block and `@E-<n>` with its own example ID, which is unique in the slice and never reused. The ExampleTagged check fails a scenario that lacks either tag, whose `@R-<n>` differs from its block's rule, or whose `@E-<n>` repeats another scenario's. The pattern refuses text whose first non-blank character is `"` or that has no real line break after its first non-blank character, which is a JSON-encoded or once-more-escaped string rather than the Gherkin itself.

questions.description: New questions. Together with the slice's earlier questions there are at most 10; more fail the proposal with TooManyQuestions.

items.description: A question the analyst asks. The platform gives it its `Q-<n>` ID.

about.description: The one item the question concerns.

options.description: Up to 5 answers to choose from. Without options, the developer gives a free answer.

items.description: A business rule in structured EARS. The slice shows its sentence in `rule_text`.

parameters.title: SliceProposal

function.name: __structured_output__
function.arguments:
{"goals":[{"id":"G-1","text":"Keep notes"},{"id":"G-2","text":"Read notes back"}],"terms":[{"id":"T-1","name":"note","definition":"A piece of text with an id."}],"rules":[{"id":"R-1","goal":"G-2","pattern":"event","trigger":"the user lists notes","system":"the notes service","response":"shall return every note in creation order","terms":["T-1"]},{"id":"R-2","goal":"G-1","pattern":"event","trigger":"the user creates a note with non-empty text","system":"the notes service","response":"shall return the note with the next id, the first being 1","terms":["T-1"]},{"id":"R-3","goal":"G-1","pattern":"unwanted","trigger":"the text of a new note is empty","system":"the notes service","response":"shall refuse to create the note","terms":["T-1"]}],"examples":"Feature: Notes
  Rule: R-1
    @R-1 @E-1
    Scenario: List returns notes in creation order
      Given notes "a" then "b" were created
      When the user lists notes
      Then the notes are returned in the order "a", "b"

  Rule: R-2
    @R-2 @E-2
    Scenario: A created note gets the next id
      When the user creates a note with text "a"
      Then the note is returned with id 1

  Rule: R-3
    @R-3 @E-3
    Scenario: Empty text is refused
      When the user creates a note with empty text
      Then the creation is refused

    @R-3 @E-4
    Scenario: Empty text is answered with a 400
      When the user creates a note with text ""
      Then the response status is 400
","contract":"openapi: 3.1.0
info: {title: notes, version: '1'}
paths:
  /notes:
    get:
      operationId: listNotes
      x-rules: [R-1]
      responses: {'200': {description: ok}}
    post:
      operationId: createNote
      x-rules: [R-2, R-3]
      responses:
        '201': {description: created}
        '400': {description: empty text}
","questions":[{"about":"R-3","text":"Is text of only spaces empty?","options":["yes","no"]},{"about":"contract/createNote","text":"Which status for an empty text?"}]}
